gaps.explanation: the first/second/last + to-infinitive: the first woman to climb.

gaps.sentence: Remember ___ your passport to the airport.
gaps.explanation: remember + to-infinitive = not forget to do something.

gaps.sentence: They managed ___ the deadline despite the strike.

gaps.explanation: there's no point + -ing: no point worrying.

gaps.sentence: The children were excited ___ the circus.
gaps.explanation: 'Excited to see' — the to-infinitive follows the adjective.

gaps.sentence: She couldn't resist ___ the last biscuit.
